hypotheses.D1_downstream_rank2: At scale 1, rank-2 Fisher-greedy modes improve median causal fidelity over absolute-eigenvalue rank-2 by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.D2_downstream_rank4: At scale 1, rank-4 Fisher-greedy median fidelity is at least 0.30 and beats the complementary modes for at least two of three categories.
hypotheses.D3_small_scale_rescue: Absolute-eigenvalue rank-1 median fidelity at scale 0.1 exceeds its scale-1 value by at least 0.20, indicating downstream curvature contributed materially to the prospective failure.
hypotheses.D4_fisher_over_value: At scale 1 and rank 4, Fisher-greedy median fidelity exceeds unweighted natural-value-greedy fidelity by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.D5_cross_scale_robustness: Fisher-greedy rank 4 has median fidelity at least 0.30 at every tested intervention scale.
